comparison.objective: Adjust a cabinet flap door’s side screw to equalize reveals, then close and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Screwdriver-slot engagement, fine rotational adjustment, repeated door-state checking, and avoiding adjacent hinge screws.
comparison.success_condition: Door ends closed, even, flush, still, and released; hinge sag from loosening the clamp screw permanently fails.
comparison.reason: This tests precision mechanism adjustment using visual gap feedback, unlike the candidate’s bimanual screen handling and physical size separation. No comparison-critical detail is missing.
